### Will You Praise Him While You Wait?
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/will-you-praise-him-while-you-wait
Passage: Psalm 13:5
Points:
- True faith learns to praise God in the middle of suffering rather than waiting for deliverance to arrive.
- Crying "How long?" expresses distressed trust in God's promises rather than godless despair.
- Pouring out honest sorrow before the Lord shifts prayer from mere venting to focused petition.
- Remembering God's steadfast love shrinks fears and turns lament into song before circumstances change.
- The cross and resurrection give believers permanent certainty that God will deal bountifully with them.

### Looking to God - Today's Insight - May 11, 2018
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-may-11-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 13:3-4
Points:
- Prolonged trials exhaust the soul, but God sovereignly appoints both their depth and duration.
- Attempting to endure distress in self-reliance breeds bitterness and self-pity instead of spiritual growth.
- Taking grief to God in prayer moves the believer from despondency to humble dependence.
- Asking God to enlighten one's eyes seeks renewed perspective and the return of inner spiritual joy.
- Bringing honest petitions to the Lord allows believers to release their adversaries into His care.
